The institutional investor held 42,946 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.27 million, down from 57,801 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Kessler Investment Group Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $932.76 billion market cap company. The stock increased 3.92% or $6.94 during the last trading session, reaching $183.83. About 53.48M shares traded or 43.44% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 6, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
